title: Shanghai AI Laboratory Releases Atria Dawn Full Version With a 512K Context Window
source_used: Pandaily (article text read from the article data embedded in the page, which the page itself served; the plain HTML had no visible body)
key_facts: Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory released the full version of Atria Dawn, an agent-oriented large model, about a month after the preview of mid-September 2026.
The model is trained on the 744-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts GLM-5.2 base and targets research and engineering work needing tool calls and multi-step tasks.
The context window grows to 512K tokens from the preview's 256K, but the project's GitHub download table still lists 256K for the full and FP8 models.
Gains over the preview: JobBench 57.5 against 50.3 (+7.2), WideSearch 84.6 against 81.9, PaperBench 89.6 against 87.0; on BrowseComp the preview's 92.5 beats the full version's 91.3.
The model is available through hosted APIs with international and China endpoints and accepts text input only.
Code is under the MIT license; weights for the full release are still listed as 'Coming soon' on Hugging Face and ModelScope.
quote_evidence: The headline change in the lab's announcement is the context window, which grows to 512K tokens from the 256K offered by the preview.
The code is released under the MIT license, but weights for the full release are still listed as 'Coming soon' on Hugging Face and ModelScope; only the preview weights can be downloaded today.
why_it_matters_hint: A Chinese AI lab's agent model gets a longer memory and modest benchmark gains, but outsiders cannot yet download or test the full version.
event_date: Not stated; full version released about a month after the mid-September 2026 preview; Pandaily published 17 Oct 2026
